values.fieldLabel: What would you like to do?

parameters.jsCode: throw new Error('Choose demo, setup, ops, maintenance, enable, submit, report, case or worker.');

parameters.content:
## IP Intelligence — Unified Investigation System
One workflow: authenticated portal, operator console and scheduled queue.

Portal: events imports JSON with a preview and explicit confirmation; worklist lists cases; submit investigates a public IP; report displays saved findings; case records an attributed explained review.

Synthetic demo event mode uses documentation addresses and creates no provider jobs. Live mode reuses provider budgets, leases and cache.

Console: demo, setup, ops, maintenance, enable. Setup SQL is for a fresh database only; existing projects apply only unrecorded migrations. Credentials remain in n8n.

See the repository release guide for schema, correlation policy, tests, deployment and evaluation limits.
